body.name: allow_finding_you
body.description: If members disable this permission, other members can't find them.

body.name: communication_consent
body.description: This attribute captures the member's preferred communication channels, such as email, SMS, or app notifications, where they have provided consent for outreach.

body.name: cbdt
body.description: This attribute is used to PII information for PII members

body.name: email_validated
body.description: Indicates if the member's email is verified or not

body.name: employee_id
body.description: Employee ID of the enrolled corporate member

body.name: favorite_sponsors
body.description: This attribute is used to capture the Favorite Sponsors of the Members.

body.name: food_preference
body.description: Member's food preference. Used to create targeted offers

body.name: gender
body.description: Captures the Member's Gender. Used to create targeted offers.

body.name: google_id
body.description: Member's Google user ID. Used when social login is enabled.

body.description: This value measures the member's influential value in the program, this can be configured in the offer. Based on the influence the member creates on other non members, we will assign certain value.

body.name: last_privilege_availment_date
body.description: Refers to the last date on which a privilege is availed by the Member

body.name: last_revenue_date
body.description: Refers to the Last Revenue date, the latest date on which the member earned points.

body.name: latitude
body.description: Latitude of the Member's Residential location

body.description: Indicates if the member's mobile number is verified or not

body.name: union_id
